title: dedicated-autoscaler-priority-routing-burst-util-reporting-v44
author: Claire Zhang
description:
Motivation: Dedicated customers have seen tail-latency spikes during short high-QPS bursts and lack clear per-fleet visibility into transient burst consumption. This PR improves the autoscaler and routing stack to: 1) add priority-aware routing for Dedicated fleets so high-priority tenants get guaranteed token-bucket burst headroom, 2) implement token-bucket smoothing and backpressure to avoid queue storms when bursts end, and 3) emit new utilization and burst-reporting metrics for per-fleet dashboards and billing reconciliation.

Summary of changes: added priority weights and per-fleet burst_capacity config, introduced a smoothing window for tokenbucket refill logic, added backpressure signals carried through the request router, and emitted new prometheus metrics (dedicated_autoscaler_burst_usage, dedicated_autoscaler_priority_headroom, dedicated_autoscaler_backpressure_active). Also updated the fleet config schema and Console dashboards.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc (linked in ENG-4321) reviewed with infra/telemetry
- [x] Unit + integration tests for tokenbucket smoothing and backpressure
- [x] Backwards-compatible config schema changes with migration notes
- [x] Observability dashboards and alerts added

Compatibility notes: config adds optional fields (burst_capacity, priority_weight) with defaults that preserve existing autoscaler behavior. No breaking API changes.

Release notes: see release_notes field.
